payload.posture: Read Psalms 41:7–10 as one movement in the Last Supper, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states the afflicted speaker describes enemies whispering, a deadly charge, and the betrayal of a trusted friend who ate his bread, then asks the LORD for mercy. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Last Supper.
